sections.heading: Product Details
sections.text:
🌤️🌙 A simple AM + PM system that works round the clock to support healthier, balanced skin

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 ✨ Helps visibly reduce dark spots, uneven patches, and dull areas over time

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 💧 Keeps your skin fresh, plump, and moisturized without feeling heavy or greasy

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🔄 Supports skin recovery while you sleep for a clearer, more even-toned look by morning

sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
🌞 Morning Routine – Hyaluronic Gel

Apply small dots of the gel on your face and neck. Gently massage in an upward motion until fully absorbed. Use daily in the morning for best results. Can be used as a base under makeup for a flawless look.

🌙 Night Care – Pigmentation Cream

After cleansing, dot the cream all over your face and neck, focusing on pigmented areas. Gently massage until absorbed. Apply every night before sleeping for an even-toned and radiant complexion.
____________________________________________________________________
NOTE:
1️⃣ Perform a patch test before use, especially for sensitive skin. Discontinue if irritation occurs.
2️⃣ Natural ingredient-based formulation may vary in color—this is normal and a sign of its effectiveness.
3️⃣ For best results, pair with our Papaya Pigmentation Facewash.

collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 India’s First AM/PM Skincare Routine — Trusted by 2+ Million Users

At Studd Muffyn, genuine feedbacks and authenticity is highly valued. After listening closely to our users and through Paras Tomar’s keen observation, we redesigned the AM PM Pigmentation Combo to make the routine smoother, lighter, and more effective for everyday skin.

The Hyaluronic Gel now comes with a matte-finish base. This improved texture helps lock extra moisture into the skin while keeping it fresh and non-greasy. The result is skin that feels deeply hydrated, balanced, and naturally glowing through the day.

We also worked on the Pigmentation Cream. Some users shared that the earlier texture felt thicker over time, so we made the new formulation lighter, thinner, and more absorbent. Now it spreads easily, settles better into the skin, and supports improved absorption without feeling heavy.

This advanced combo is made for people who want a practical AM-PM routine for pigmentation, dark spots, dullness, and uneven skin tone.

What's New?

💧 13 Types of Hyaluronic Acids

🍑 Papaya + Kojic Acid + Niacinamide

🌿 Fruit & Plant Extract Blend

🎯 Better Absorption, More Hydration

“Pigmentation doesn’t need 10 products. It needs the right routine at the right time.”

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Ingredients
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 💧 Hyaluronic Matte Gel Advanced

Aqua, HYA Complex HD / Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin & Saccharide Isomerate, Papaya, Kiwi, Watermelon, Orange, Pomegranate & Apple Extracts, Aloe Vera & Jojoba Extract, Niacinamide & Betaine, Centella Asiatica Exosome Extract / Gotu Kola, Allantoin, 

Other Base Ingredients: Disodium EDTA, Propylene Glycol, Carbomer, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Triethanolamine, Xylitylglucoside, Anhydroxylitol, Xylitol, Parfum, CI 42090

🍑 Pigmentation Papaya Anti Blemish Matte Gel Advanced

Aqua, Kojic Acid Dipalmitate, Niacinamide, Papaya Extract, Licorice Extract, Red Algae Extract, Aloe Vera Extract, Neem Oil, Olive Oil, Sesame Oil & Sweet Almond Oil, Shea Butter & Cocoa Butter, Sodium Hyaluronate & Pentavitin,

Other Base Ingredients: Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Propanediol, Allantoin, Betaine, Cetyl Alcohol, Stearic Acid, Glyceryl Stearate & PEG-100 Stearate, Isopropyl Myristate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cyclopentasiloxane, Triethanolamine, Polysorbate 20, Phenoxyethanol & Ethylhexylglycerin, Aquaxyl, Approved Fragrance

 <div class="

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What is the Advanced AM PM Pigmentation Combo used for?

It is a day-and-night skincare combo designed to support hydration, glow, dark spot care, blemish care, and more even-looking skin. 

Q2. Which product should I use in the morning?

Use the Hyaluronic Matte Gel Advanced in the morning.

Q3. Which product should I use at night?

Use the Pigmentation Papaya Anti-Blemish Matte Gel Advanced at night.

Q4. Can this combo help with dark spots?

Yes, the PM formula is designed to help reduce the appearance of dark spots and blemishes while supporting brighter, more even-looking skin.

Q5. Is this combo only for pigmentation?

No. Along with pigmentation care, the combo also supports hydration, moisture balance, glow, skin texture, and dullness care, making it a complete AM-PM routine.

Q6. Can I use the AM gel under sunscreen or makeup?

Yes, the AM Hyaluronic Matte Gel Advanced can be used in the morning before sunscreen.

Q7. How often should I use this combo?

Use it daily: AM gel in the morning and PM pigmentation gel at night.

Q8. Does it contain Niacinamide?

Yes, both the new AM and PM products mention Niacinamide as part of their upgraded ingredient story.

Q9. Is patch test required?

Yes, a patch test is recommended before use.

Q10. Who can use this combo?

This combo is suitable for anyone looking for a simple routine for hydrated, brighter, smoother, and more even-looking skin, especially when dealing with dullness, dark spots, blemishes, or uneven tone.
